basic.name: Flamestrike
basic.description:
After 1 second, deal 345~~0.04~~ damage in an area. 

Verdant Spheres increases the radius by 50%.

basic.name: Living Bomb
basic.description:
Deal 126~~0.04~~ damage over 3 seconds to an enemy, then they explode dealing 215~~0.04~~ damage to all nearby enemies.  Other Heroes damaged by this explosion are also affected by Living Bomb, though the secondary explosions cannot spread.

Verdant Spheres makes this Ability cost no Mana and have no cooldown.

basic.name: Gravity Lapse
basic.description:
Stun the first enemy hit for 1 second. 

Verdant Spheres causes Gravity Lapse to stun the first 3 enemies hit and increases the stun duration by 50%.

heroic.name: Pyroblast
heroic.description: After 1.5 seconds, cast a slow-moving fireball that deals 810~~0.05~~ damage to an enemy Hero and 405~~0.05~~ damage to enemies nearby.

heroic.name: Phoenix
heroic.description: Launch a Phoenix to an area, dealing 84~~0.04~~ damage to enemies along the way. The Phoenix persists for 7 seconds, attacking enemies for 84~~0.04~~ damage and splashing for 42~~0.04~~ damage.

heroic.name: Phoenix Retarget
heroic.description: Send the Phoenix to a different area.

trait.name: Verdant Spheres
trait.description: Activate to make Kael'thas's next Basic Ability more powerful.

trait.name: Verdant Spheres Active
trait.description: Kael'thas's next Basic Ability is more powerful

activable.name: Arcane Barrier
activable.description: Gain a Shield equal to 100% of Kael'thas's maximum Mana for 4 seconds.

level1.name: Convection
level1.description:
Repeatable Quest: Hit 20 enemy Heroes with Flamestrike without dying.

Repeatable Reward: Permanently increases Flamestrike damage by 200, and Kael'thas's maximum Health by 100.

level1.name: Fel Infusion
level1.description: Increases Kael'thas's Spell Power by 4%. Kael'thas heals for 94~~0.04~~ Health when activating Verdant Spheres.

level1.name: Mana Addict
level1.description:
Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases Kael'thas's maximum Mana by 15.

Reward: After gathering 20 Globes, Kael'thas can activate Arcane Barrier to gain a Shield equal to 100% of his maximum Mana for 4 seconds. 45 second cooldown.

level4.name: Nether Wind
level4.description: Increases Gravity Lapse's range by 30%. When Gravity Lapse hits an enemy Hero, refund 80 Mana.

level4.name: Energy Roil
level4.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Gravity Lapse by 70. If Gravity Lapse hits a Hero, reduce its cooldown by 8 seconds.

level4.name: Mana Tap
level4.description: Activating Verdant Spheres restores 5% of Kael'thas's maximum Mana.

level7.name: Burned Flesh
level7.description: When Flamestrike damages 2 or more Heroes, they take additional damage equal to 8% of their maximum Health.

level7.name: Sun King's Fury
level7.description: Living Bombs that have spread to enemy Heroes deal 35% more damage.

level7.name: Sunfire Enchantment
level7.description: Activating Verdant Spheres causes Kael'thas's next 2 Basic Attacks to instead deal 115~~0.04~~ Spell Damage. If both of these Attacks hit enemy Heroes, gain 15% Spell Power for 10 seconds.

level10.name: Phoenix
level10.description: Launch a Phoenix to an area, dealing 84~~0.04~~ damage to enemies along the way. The Phoenix persists for 7 seconds, attacking enemies for 84~~0.04~~ damage and splashing for 42~~0.04~~ damage.

level10.name: Pyroblast
level10.description: After 1.5 seconds, cast a slow-moving fireball that deals 810~~0.05~~ damage to an enemy Hero and 405~~0.05~~ damage to enemies nearby.

level13.name: Pyromaniac
level13.description: Each time Living Bomb deals periodic damage, Kael'thas's Basic Ability cooldowns are reduced by 0.5 seconds.

level13.name: Backdraft
level13.description: Living Bomb's explosion slows enemy Movement Speed by 30% for 2 seconds.

level13.name: Fission Bomb
level13.description: Increases Living Bomb's explosion radius by 20%.

level16.name: Fury of the Sunwell
level16.description: Flamestrike will explode a second time 1.5 seconds later.

level16.name: Ignite
level16.description: Flamestrikes apply Living Bomb to the enemy Hero closest to its center who is not currently affected by Living Bomb.

level16.name: Twin Spheres
level16.description:
Verdant Spheres gains a second charge.

Passive: Kael'thas benefits from all of his level 7 talents.

level20.name: Rebirth
level20.description: Increases Phoenix duration by 100%. While alive, the Phoenix may be ordered to move to a different location. Stores 3 charges.

level20.name: Presence Of Mind
level20.description: Increases Pyroblast's explosion radius by 50%. Heroes that are hit by Flamestrike or have Living Bomb spread to them reduce the cooldown of Pyroblast by 10 seconds.

level20.name: Master of Flames
level20.description: Living Bomb's spread from explosions can now also spread Living Bomb.

level20.name: Flamethrower
level20.description: Increases the cast range of Flamestrike by 40%. If Flamestrike hits 2 or more Heroes, its cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds.
